lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Four kingdoms on one field, and every banner|pointed the same way. It had never happened.
lines.text: Four kingdoms on one field, and every banner pointed the same way. It had never happened.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Well. Look at the four of you. Thirty years I|waited to see this, and it's ugly. I love it.
lines.text: Well. Look at the four of you. Thirty years I waited to see this, and it's ugly. I love it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Fire takes its bank.|Or wherever I'm standing. I'm flexible.
lines.text: Fire takes its bank. Or wherever I'm standing. I'm flexible.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice holds its bank. Malrik, if that stone|so much as hums, I'm freezing your pocket.
lines.text: Ice holds its bank. Malrik, if that stone so much as hums, I'm freezing your pocket.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Noted. Ysolde, try not to|plant anything on my keyhole.
lines.text: Noted. Ysolde, try not to plant anything on my keyhole.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: No promises. Spring is busy.
lines.text: No promises. Spring is busy.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Four of you. FOUR. I only needed one|to come close. You brought me a feast.
lines.text: Four of you. FOUR. I only needed one to come close. You brought me a feast.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Gates on every road. He's been building|while we argued. Mason to the end.
lines.text: Gates on every road. He's been building while we argued. Mason to the end.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: The pylon's down! Now the Hollow knows|your key is coming. Hold the ring!
lines.text: The pylon's down! Now the Hollow knows your key is coming. Hold the ring!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: They're all over my keyhole!|I could use a hand. Or ten.
lines.text: They're all over my keyhole! I could use a hand. Or ten.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The Bishop requests assistance. Politely. Once.
lines.text: The Bishop requests assistance. Politely. Once.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: My line is bending. Help me hold it.|I'm asking. Note that.
lines.text: My line is bending. Help me hold it. I'm asking. Note that.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They're in my roots! Please.|Now, not in a season.
lines.text: They're in my roots! Please. Now, not in a season.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: That's what friends are for.|Apparently. Don't tell Malrik.
lines.text: That's what friends are for. Apparently. Don't tell Malrik.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Hm. Help that arrives on time.|Unsettling. Thank you.
lines.text: Hm. Help that arrives on time. Unsettling. Thank you.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: You came quickly. I'll try|to learn how that's done.
lines.text: You came quickly. I'll try to learn how that's done.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: You came. I always hoped|someone would, when it was me.
lines.text: You came. I always hoped someone would, when it was me.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Every one who falls is a step on|my stair. Keep climbing for me.
lines.text: Every one who falls is a step on my stair. Keep climbing for me.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Stop feeding it! Fight smart,|or fight later. Later is worse.
lines.text: Stop feeding it! Fight smart, or fight later. Later is worse.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Marching now! Fire on the bridge.|Somebody watch my back, I won't.
lines.text: Marching now! Fire on the bridge. Somebody watch my back, I won't.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Shadow marches. The stone stays in|my pocket. Mostly I'm telling myself.
lines.text: Shadow marches. The stone stays in my pocket. Mostly I'm telling myself.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice is moving. I know. Write it down somewhere.
lines.text: Ice is moving. I know. Write it down somewhere.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Nature marches out. Again. It's getting easier.
lines.text: Nature marches out. Again. It's getting easier.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Fire's key is in! Don't make|me wait. I'm terrible at it.
lines.text: Fire's key is in! Don't make me wait. I'm terrible at it.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Shadow's lock is turned.|You may thank me in writing.
lines.text: Shadow's lock is turned. You may thank me in writing.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice is set. That was quick, for me.
lines.text: Ice is set. That was quick, for me.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Nature's key is home. The roots are holding it.
lines.text: Nature's key is home. The roots are holding it.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.subtitle: Last stall before the end of the world!|Again! I'm getting good at these.
lines.text: Last stall before the end of the world! Again! I'm getting good at these.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.subtitle: Genuine relic polish! For your keys!|Four keys, four customers, I can't lose.
lines.text: Genuine relic polish! For your keys! Four keys, four customers, I can't lose.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Those are mine. Were mine. They followed the|stone. They'll follow it into the ground.
lines.text: Those are mine. Were mine. They followed the stone. They'll follow it into the ground.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Renegades on the Shadow side!|Whoever's nearest, lend the Bishop a blade.
lines.text: Renegades on the Shadow side! Whoever's nearest, lend the Bishop a blade.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Too slow, all of you. I'm already climbing.
lines.text: Too slow, all of you. I'm already climbing.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: One gate less. Build something|on the rubble. He'd hate that.
lines.text: One gate less. Build something on the rubble. He'd hate that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Four keyholes, four colours,|one ring of light around the isle.
lines.text: Four keyholes, four colours, one ring of light around the isle.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Now. All four of you.|Turn them, and do not let go.
lines.text: Now. All four of you. Turn them, and do not let go.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Master?! That's... that's him! Turn them!
lines.text: Master?! That's... that's him! Turn them!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Of course he waits until the last|minute to speak. Family trait.
lines.text: Of course he waits until the last minute to speak. Family trait.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: You opened my door with your own|hands. Thank you. Now I come up.
lines.text: You opened my door with your own hands. Thank you. Now I come up.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then let him come. We are four. We hold.
lines.text: Then let him come. We are four. We hold.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Your keep's burning!|Pull back and hold it, then go again.
lines.text: Your keep's burning! Pull back and hold it, then go again.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: My key's in. I waited for it, too. Who's next?
lines.text: My key's in. I waited for it, too. Who's next?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The stone is in its lock.|Not in my hand. Who's next?
lines.text: The stone is in its lock. Not in my hand. Who's next?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The orb is turned. Quickly. For me. Who's next?
lines.text: The orb is turned. Quickly. For me. Who's next?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The Signet is home.|I'm still out here. Who's next?
lines.text: The Signet is home. I'm still out here. Who's next?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Together.
lines.text: Together.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Not now... not when we're finally together...
lines.text: Not now... not when we're finally together...

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Of course. Just as it got interesting.
lines.text: Of course. Just as it got interesting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too late... again...
lines.text: Too late... again...

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I came out... for this...
lines.text: I came out... for this...
